results.detail: Single OLE DB Source on [PSQL] (PSQL/ALTSHULER_MSCRM); UNION of four parts (transfer-in, transfer-in out-side, withdrawal, customercare/TransOut per SQL comments) with dateadd(hh,8,date) in [GETUTCDATE(), GETUTCDATE()+5] and Gen_BankNumber='10'; grouped by date/product; Percent calc and *100; Excel Destination only. Component classes in the package: OLEDBSource, 2x DerivedColumn, ExcelDestination; no script, no OLE DB Command, no configurations, no log provider, no event handlers; [Excel Connection Manager] referenced by nothing.
Two Success/LogicalAnd constraints: Copy Template -> Expected Transfer Value -> Rename File Name; Copy has no incoming constraint.
Only OLEDBSource reads [PSQL]; the only destination is the Excel Destination on [Excel Connection Manager 1].

Parts are joined with 'union' (DTSX:168, 189, 213), which removes duplicate 7-column rows (expecteddate, valueamount, fundtypename, fundfinanceid, fundtotalassets, producttypecode, bankname) before SUM; consequence worded conditionally ('עלול').
CASE without ELSE in the transfer-in part; SUM ignores NULLs; all-NULL group yields NULL and Percent calc ISNULL(valueamount) ? 0 gives 0.
SQL maps unknown codes to 0; Producttypename expression maps anything not 1/2 to the third label.
Expression pads hh/mi/ss via Right("0"+...,2) but appends (DT_STR,2,1252) datepart("mm") and datepart("dd") unpadded; e.g. Jan 11 and Nov 1 both yield '...<yyyy>111'. Worded conditionally.
[Excel Connection Manager] has ExcelFilePath=@[User::ExcelFilePath] and DelayValidation=True; no component or task references its refId/DTSID; Excel Destination uses [Excel Connection Manager 1].

Copy with TaskOverwriteDestFile=True from G:\Expectedtransfervalue\Template\expected.xls to G:\Expectedtransfervalue\expected.xls verified. short_he calls the template 'empty' (קובץ תבנית ריק). The template file is not supplied, so its content is unknown. The package only shows it must hold sheet '1$' with the 8 header columns the Excel Destination maps to (HDR=YES); any existing rows would remain, because the destination appends.

wrongUnits.correct: A copy of the template file (content not supplied; at design time it holds sheet '1$' with the report's header columns) overwrites the output file.

results.detail: Questions [2] and [3] cannot be settled from the files and are correctly open/hypothesis. Question [1] is answerable from the statement itself. The fourth part references Product.gen_fundtotalassets, so Product has the column, and Product is joined in all four parts. If another joined table also had gen_fundtotalassets, the unqualified references would be ambiguous and the query would fail. So whenever the flow runs, the unqualified gen_fundtotalassets is Product.gen_fundtotalassets.

wrongUnits.correct: Unqualified gen_fundtotalassets resolves to Product.gen_fundtotalassets (proven column of Product, joined in every part; otherwise the query would be ambiguous).

results.detail: RenameFile from User::Destination to User::ExcelFilePath (excpect + hhmiss + yyyy + m + d + .xls).

Units [1]-[2] verified. End [3] claims the report gets a name unique to each run. The name is not guaranteed unique: month/day are unpadded, so different dates can collide (finding#5), two runs in the same second collide, and TaskOverwriteDestFile=True silently overwrites an existing file with that name.

wrongUnits.correct: The report is renamed with a time+date stamp; names can collide (unpadded month/day, same-second runs) and an existing file with the same name is overwritten.
